Raw nextest diagnostic13.237s at normal priority is not comparable gate proof; authoritative normal-nice gate911fbb9e passed14.542s suite,4580tests+25docs. rules: Worktree source edits only; at most two active worktrees for this lead; >=60GB free before dispatch. CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0. Builds: flock -o /tmp/jit-ci-turnstile.lock flock -o -s /tmp/jit-full-ci.lock <command>. Full validation and main merges use -x instead of -s. Do not pre-acquire cargo-ci.lock. Current main must be incorporated into the task branch and full workspace nextest plus workspace doctests pass before merge. No broad lock cleanup or fixture-timeout force exemption. Exact-path tracker commits. Fixed breakdown; scope changes escalate to coordinator 01a164c8-d7ba-7812-a630-db8dddcee05b.
